title: Laredo Utilities announces two planned water outages Monday
excerpt: The Laredo Utilities Department announced two planned water outages for Monday, Nov. 9 — one in District 6 on Shama Circle and one in District 1 at Cielito Lindo Boulevard and Cuartro Vientos Road.
content:
The Laredo Utilities Department announced two planned water outages for Monday, Nov. 9, according to KGNS.

The first outage is in District 6, in the 8800 block of Shama Circle, and started at 10 a.m. Monday, lasting six to eight hours, KGNS reported. It was not yet determined whether any customers would be affected.

The second outage is in District 1, at Cielito Lindo Boulevard and Cuartro Vientos Road, and started at 9 a.m. Monday, with no customers affected, according to KGNS. No end time was stated.

No reason for the outages was given in the announcement.

Sources: KGNS, November 9, 2026.
